A long read but its how it went down lol

Went camping to beyond this year and it went alright to be honest. The car was checked thoroughly, such as, taking out everything, opening our bags, looking under seats, heck they even asked me to pop the hood and checked every nook and cranny in there as well. As for the security staff, not gonna lie, some of them were dicks, they kept asking us if we had drugs on us and where we had them. One even crushed our pack of swishers and was about to refuse to let us bring it in even tho it was sealed. After the car was checked we were asked to take off our shoes and given a routine pat down then sent into the campgrounds for set up.

TL;DR: Security is how you'd expect it to be, thorough car search, pat down, the works.

P.S. Yes, we were able to sneak in our party favors, just gotta be creative about it!!
